text: Do not call any standard power or floating-point exponentiation function: `std::pow`, `pow`, `powf`, `powl`.

Compute each modular power using binary exponentiation (exponentiation by squaring, iterative or recursive) that halves the exponent at each step in O(log e) multiplications. Multiplying the base one step at a time in an O(e) loop does not satisfy this constraint, whatever the function is called.
